intro: Power Greens at CAVA offers a nutrient-dense, low-calorie base option for health-conscious diners. This carefully curated mixed leafy greens blend provides essential vitamins and minerals while keeping your bowl light and fresh. As part of the [CAVA Bases Menu](/menu/bases), Power Greens delivers just 30 calories with 2g of protein, making it an excellent foundation for building your perfect customized bowl from the [full CAVA menu](/).
priceCalories: Power Greens is included as a complimentary base option with any CAVA bowl or pita order, adding no extra cost to your meal. At only 30 calories per serving, this leafy greens blend is the lowest-calorie base available. With 2g of protein, 4g of carbs, and 0g of fat, Power Greens provides a guilt-free foundation that lets you save calories for flavorful [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads) additions.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets Power Greens apart is its expertly balanced mixed leafy greens blend that combines multiple varieties for optimal nutrition and taste. Unlike single-green salads, this thoughtfully crafted mix delivers diverse nutrients, textures, and flavors in every bite. The blend stays crisp and fresh while absorbing dressings beautifully. Power Greens serves as the perfect canvas for showcasing CAVA's Mediterranean-inspired toppings and proteins without overwhelming your palate.
nutritionFacts: Power Greens delivers impressive nutrition in a low-calorie package. Each serving contains 30 calories, 2g protein, 4g carbohydrates, and 0g fat. This macronutrient profile makes it ideal for weight management and clean eating. The mixed leafy greens provide fiber, vitamins A, C, and K, plus iron and calcium. Check the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) to track your complete bowl nutrition and explore the [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu) for dietary information.
whatsInside: Power Greens features a premium mixed leafy greens blend carefully selected for nutritional value and taste. While the exact varieties may vary seasonally, the blend typically includes nutrient-rich options like spinach, kale, romaine, and other leafy greens. Each variety contributes unique vitamins, minerals, and phytonutrients. The greens are washed, chopped to the perfect size, and kept fresh daily to ensure optimal quality and crispness in every bowl.
tasteLike: Power Greens offers a mild, fresh, and slightly earthy flavor profile that does not overpower other ingredients. The mixed blend provides varied textures from tender to slightly crisp leaves, creating an interesting mouthfeel. The taste is clean and vegetal without bitterness, making it universally appealing. The greens readily absorb dressings and juices from [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains) proteins, enhancing overall flavor complexity while maintaining their refreshing character.
customize: Customize your Power Greens base by pairing it with any protein from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains) like Grilled Chicken, Spicy Lamb Meatballs, or Falafel. Layer on your favorite [CAVA Toppings Menu](/toppings) such as tomatoes, cucumbers, pickled onions, and feta. Add richness with hummus or tzatziki, then finish with your choice from the [CAVA Dressings Menu](/dressings). Build your perfect bowl by mixing Power Greens with grains for added substance.
pairsWell: Power Greens pairs exceptionally well with bold Mediterranean flavors and hearty proteins. Try it with Harissa Honey Chicken for sweet-spicy contrast, or Braised Lamb for rich, savory depth. The greens complement creamy dips like Crazy Feta and Hummus perfectly. Add Kalamata olives, fire-roasted corn, and diced cucumbers for texture variety. Tahini Caesar or Lemon Herb Tahini dressings enhance the greens without overwhelming their delicate flavor profile.
healthyChoice: Power Greens stands out as one of the healthiest base options at CAVA. With only 30 calories and zero fat, it supports weight loss and heart health goals. The 2g of protein and high fiber content promote satiety and digestive health. Rich in antioxidants, vitamins, and minerals, this leafy greens blend supports immune function and overall wellness. For those following the [CAVA Gluten Free Menu](/gluten-free), Power Greens is naturally gluten-free and fits various dietary patterns.
howToOrder: Order Power Greens easily at any [CAVA Locations](/locations) by selecting it as your base when building a custom bowl or pita. Simply tell the team member you would like Power Greens as your foundation. You can also choose from [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) options that feature Power Greens, or request it as a substitution in any signature bowl. When ordering online, select Power Greens from the bases section first.
vsAlternatives: Compared to other bases, Power Greens offers the fewest calories at 30 versus Super Greens at 35, Brown Rice at 310, Saffron Basmati Rice at 290, and Black Lentils at 270 calories. While grain bases provide more protein and sustained energy, Power Greens excels for low-carb, low-calorie eating. Super Greens includes additional cabbage for extra crunch, while Power Greens focuses purely on tender leafy varieties for a softer texture.
whoShouldTry: Power Greens is perfect for health-conscious diners, those following low-carb or keto diets, and anyone watching their calorie intake. Vegetable lovers who appreciate fresh, quality greens will enjoy this base. Fitness enthusiasts seeking nutrient-dense, low-calorie options should definitely try Power Greens. It also works well for lighter lunch options or for diners who want to save calories for indulgent toppings and dressings while maintaining nutritional balance.
worthTrying: Power Greens is absolutely worth trying for anyone seeking a nutritious, flavorful base at CAVA. At zero extra cost and only 30 calories, you risk nothing while gaining exceptional nutritional benefits. The fresh, crisp texture and mild flavor create the perfect foundation for Mediterranean ingredients to shine. Whether you are health-focused or simply love quality salad greens, Power Greens delivers taste, nutrition, and value in every bowl.

faqs.q: How many calories are in CAVA Power Greens?
faqs.a: CAVA Power Greens contains 30 calories per serving, making it the lowest-calorie base option available. With 2g protein, 4g carbs, and 0g fat, it provides excellent nutrition with minimal calories.

faqs.q: Is Power Greens included in the base price at CAVA?
faqs.a: Yes, Power Greens is included as a complimentary base option with any CAVA bowl or pita. There is no additional charge when selecting Power Greens as your foundation.

faqs.q: What greens are in CAVA Power Greens blend?
faqs.a: Power Greens features a mixed leafy greens blend that typically includes varieties like spinach, kale, romaine, and other nutrient-rich greens. The exact blend may vary seasonally for optimal freshness and quality.

faqs.q: Is Power Greens gluten-free and suitable for special diets?
faqs.a: Yes, Power Greens is naturally gluten-free and fits various dietary patterns including vegetarian, vegan, keto, paleo, and Whole30. It is also dairy-free and contains no common allergens beyond trace cross-contact possibilities.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Power Greens and Super Greens at CAVA?
faqs.a: Power Greens has 30 calories and focuses on tender leafy varieties, while Super Greens has 35 calories and includes shredded cabbage for extra crunch. Both are healthy, low-calorie bases with similar nutritional profiles and complementary textures.
